content.text: Submitted. The proposal now sits wholly at the fallback level: a single concise insert after §10.4 confirming M&I's ownership of its generic tools and know-how and granting Customer a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense the Developed Software for its business. The prior preferred-level rewrite (0.751 ratio, hybrid rights, deleted refund/credit mechanic and cross-reference boilerplate) is removed, and all official checks and the minimality gate pass.
